What this board is

Rung 3 of the logo ladder, as a generated mark instead of a letter. When an entry has no icon and no brand in the registry, the well today shows the first letter of the name. This board tries the hash-based avatar libraries in that same 40px well, with the real catalog ids as seeds, so the choice is made on the marks themselves. Whatever is picked runs locally (no network, deterministic for the same id) and replaces the monogram in MarketplaceEntryLogo; the monogram stays as the last rung for a broken render.

Decision — Boring Avatars “marble”, default palette (Pedro, 2026-09-10)

decided
1 · DiceBear “shapes” or “glyphs” (recommended)MIT core, CC0 style, the most maintained project of the set (pushed this month), 63 styles to switch without changing code, and Go/Rust ports if the daemon ever has to render the same mark. Shapes reads closest to Codex’s and Grok’s tiles. bun add @dicebear/core @dicebear/styles
2 · Boring Avatars “bauhaus” or “marble”Best-looking gradients, tiny, and a colors prop that takes our ramp so the marks can be tinted instead of loud. React-only (fine for web). Less active than DiceBear, single maintainer.
3 · Jdenticon (muted)The classic identicon, dependency-free, fully tunable to greys. Reads “technical” — good if we want marks that never compete with real logos. No release since 2024.

Decided. Pedro picked Boring Avatars · marble · default palette from the in-context rows (§01). The library palette is accepted in this well as the identity of a thing — an authorized delta to “color = state”, scoped to the logo well only. The recommendation text below is kept as the record of the alternatives. Original tension note. The design system says color marks live state, never taxonomy, and reserves identity color for profiles. Every library below is colorful by default. Two ways out, shown side by side in the grids: keep the library’s palette and accept color as “identity of a thing” in this one well (Grok/Codex do this), or pass our neutral ramp (Boring Avatars, Bauhaus, Jdenticon grayscale/muted, Minidenticons muted) so the mark is shape-first and the well stays calm. My recommendation: neutral ramp by default, with the palette variant kept as an option in the settings appearance page if you want it.

Every mark above is library output for the seed shown in its tooltip (real entry_ids from catalog/*.json plus the plugin fixtures). Generated 2026-09-10 in a throwaway lab (/tmp/avatar-lab/gen.mjs) with the npm versions named in each section; repository facts from the GitHub API the same day. DiceBear styles outside the CC0 list (Lorelei, Avataaars, …) carry attribution licenses and are not shown. Nothing here is a Visual Contract until Pedro picks one.
